name: Build Inkplate 6 MOTION demo

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  firmware:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out official Inkplate Motion library
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Arduino CLI on hosted x86-64 Linux
        uses: arduino/setup-arduino-cli@v2
        with:
          version: 1.5.1

      - name: Install official Soldered board and tools
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BOARD_URL=https://github.com/SolderedElectronics/Dasduino-Board-Definitions-for-Arduino-IDE/raw/master/package_Dasduino_Boards_index.json
          arduino-cli core update-index --additional-urls "$BOARD_URL"
          arduino-cli core install Inkplate_Motion:stm32@1.0.2 --additional-urls "$BOARD_URL"

      - name: Correct Soldered prebuild shell portability bug
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re
          script = Path.home()/'.arduino15/packages/Inkplate_Motion/hardware/stm32/1.0.2/system/extras/prebuild.sh'
          source = script.read_text()
          patched, count = re.subn(r'\$\{BOARD_PLATFORM_PATH//[^}]*\}', '${BOARD_PLATFORM_PATH}', source)
          if count != 2:
              raise SystemExit(f'Unexpected Soldered prebuild script: expected 2 Bash substitutions; found {count}')
          script.write_text(patched)
          print('Patched 2 nonportable substitutions.')
          PY

      - name: Install library from checked-out official repository
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$HOME/Arduino/libraries"
          ln -s "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$HOME/Arduino/libraries/InkplateMotion"

      - name: Compile official Simple B&W display example
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/firmware"
          arduino-cli compile \
            --fqbn Inkplate_Motion:stm32:Inkplate6Motion \
            --output-dir "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/firmware" \
            "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/examples/Inkplate6Motion/Basic/Inkplate_6_Motion_Simple_BW"
          find "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/firmware" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %s bytes\n'
          find "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/firmware" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.bin' | grep -q . || {
            echo 'ERROR: No .bin firmware was generated'
            exit 1
          }

      - name: Save firmware binary for download
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: inkplate-6-motion-bw-firmware
          path: firmware/*.bin
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
